title: HNM ordered bulk-state identification
target: Identify the deep-bulk translates of the actual inherited positive-orthant state with the local normal limit of centered whole-star boxes, using independent-cutoff comparison before taking limits.
model: Exactly AN1's untruncated 24-link SU(2) factors with one fixed coarse-translation-invariant selected coefficient triple, homogeneous omitted tau, full endpoint gauge actions and fixed positive physical scales.
premises: Inherited I1 orthant state under its original |tau|<tau_* restriction
Additional HTW smallness 7|tau|<=c_HTW(1,1), source constants positive but unevaluated
AN1 bounded-commutator domain and actual-boundary dictionary

frozen_geometry.orthant_cutoff: [0,L]^3 shifted by -b_n for every integer L>=2n
frozen_geometry.observable_region: Every fixed finite nonempty complete-factor F contained in [-r,r]^3, n>=r+2

required: Uniform comparison independent of outer L and M, with distance at least n-r-1 and bound exp(C1|F|-C2(n-r-1)) capped at2
Centered normal marginal Cauchy proof for all large pairs M,M', not only a diagonal sequence
For fixed n first pass orthant L to infinity using the actual inherited local limit; only then pass n to infinity
Compatible positive trace-one local limits define a state on the norm-closed local algebra; gauge invariance and coarse translation invariance require explicit justification
Distinguish equality of these specified local states from identity of dynamics, generators, gaps or all possible boundary limits
controls: A triangular-array example where diagonal convergence alone misidentifies iterated limits
Moving near-boundary region with no diverging distance
Only one fixed marginal without compatibility
Illegal interchange of outer cutoff and translation limits
acceptance: Full ordered analytic limit argument under source hypotheses, independently checked geometry and logical countercontrols. Sample expectations or a common spectral gap do not suffice.
next_loop: After this review completes all three initial pairs, select the final two goals from the accumulated evidence. No later production is authorized by this contract.
